# Sent

> > Sent provides SMS, WhatsApp, and RCS messaging infrastructure with comprehensive documentation covering API integration, country-specific compliance regulations, and carrier requirements.

Sent is a messaging platform offering developers and businesses tools to send SMS, WhatsApp, and RCS messages globally. The platform provides extensive documentation on regulatory compliance (including ARPCE, LQPD, Law 25.326, Law 26.951), sender ID registration requirements, and integration guides for multiple countries and messaging providers like Twilio, Sinch, MessageBird, and Plivo.

## Key Topics

- SMS compliance and regulations
- WhatsApp Business messaging
- RCS (Rich Communication Services)
- API integration and documentation
- Sender ID registration
- Country-specific messaging guides
- ARPCE (Argentina regulatory authority)
- LQPD (Quebec privacy law)
- Law 25.326 (Argentina data protection)
- Law 26.951 (Argentina SMS regulations)
- Messaging provider integrations (Twilio, Sinch, MessageBird, Plivo)
- SMS technical specifications
- Regulatory compliance requirements
- Messaging best practices
